text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Protesters pelted the Education Ministry with eggs on the fourth day of secondary school demonstrations, breaking all windows. There were fewer demonstrators.
- Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov is expected to receive a delegation of Macedonian students from the teachers' academy.
- Helsinki human rights committee said it was time to start talking about using national minority languages in Macedonia without provoking political passions and xenophobia.
- The ruling socialists accused the opposition of organising demonstrations and manipulating children for political goals.
- Italian President Osar Luigi Scalfaro will address Macedonian parliament on February 26. Macedonia is expected to ask Italy to support its faster integration into NATO and EU.
